description: Land Acquisition - Kaduruwela, Thamankaduwa D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions (garden, paddy field, road, etc.), claimants, and exact measurements. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" which is specifically covered by Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
